outcome: Multi-label comparison preserves set evidence and label transitions without turning sets into classes.

artifacts.purpose: Typed multi-label paired result and transitions
Set transition and conditional population cases

interfaces: Per-label transition states absent/present/abstained; each 3x3 table sums to common N.
Each episode stores both sources/outcomes/correctness and matched/missed/extra or explicit abstention state.
Answered-only metrics expose both answered IDs/counts and overlap, not a paired improvement claim.
acceptance_criteria: A->{B} against {A,B} remains neither_correct but changed; changed ID is retained.
Whole abstention maps every label to abstained; no power-set enumeration.
Selected population equality never implies answered population equality; both family populations remain explicit.

verification.expected: Exact expected tables and all correctness/changed ID categories verified.
Equal selected counts with different answers expose both sides and overlap.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
